enforcement_levels.name: requires_entitlement
enforcement_levels.description: Enforced after the OS grants a special entitlement (e.g. VPN consent, Network Extension).

enforcement_levels.name: requires_vpn_profile
enforcement_levels.description: Enforced only while an Umbra tunnel/VPN profile is active.

enforcement_levels.name: requires_rooted_os
enforcement_levels.description: Only possible with root or a custom OS build.

enforcement_levels.name: advisory
enforcement_levels.description: The app can measure and warn, but cannot change it.

enforcement_levels.name: unavailable
enforcement_levels.description: Not applicable or impossible on this platform.

firewall.description: Do not be reachable from the local network (default-deny inbound).

hostname.description: Do not broadcast a stable hostname over DHCP.

ipv6_privacy.description: Use rotating IPv6 privacy addresses, not a stable EUI-64.

kernel.description: Apply kernel hardening (restricted pointers/dmesg/ptrace, full ASLR).

mac.description: Randomize the Wi-Fi MAC so the hardware address is not a tracker.

telemetry.description: Block OS/app phone-home and telemetry destinations.

tor.description: Route all traffic through Tor with an egress killswitch.

webcam_off.description: Disable the camera at the device level.

wireguard.description: Route all traffic through a WireGuard tunnel with an egress killswitch.

linux.description: Reference implementation. Enforces every control directly (nftables, systemd, sysctl, rfkill, Tor).

android.description: VPNService-based. Real egress/DNS/tunnel control without root; kernel and system firewall need root.

bluetooth_off.reason: Android 13+ blocks apps from toggling the radio; guide the user to the toggle

discovery.reason: system owns mDNS/NSD; an app cannot silence it without root

firewall.reason: a system inbound firewall needs root; unrooted Android already sandboxes inbound per-app

hostname.reason: modern Android randomizes the DHCP hostname itself; app can only verify

ipv6_privacy.reason: Android enables IPv6 privacy addresses by default; not app-toggleable

kernel.reason: sysctl hardening requires root / a custom ROM

mac.reason: Android 10+ randomizes MAC per-SSID by default; app verifies, cannot force

telemetry.reason: sinkhole telemetry domains via a local VPNService DNS filter

tor.reason: route all traffic through Tor via a VPNService packet tunnel

webcam_off.reason: no module unload; guide to the OS camera kill-switch / permission revoke

wireguard.reason: native WireGuard over VPNService after a one-time VPN-consent grant

ios.description: Network Extension-based. DNS and the tunnel via an entitlement; nearly everything else is advisory.

bluetooth_off.reason: no programmatic radio toggle; guide the user to Control Center

firewall.reason: iOS exposes no app-level inbound firewall

hostname.reason: iOS manages the DHCP hostname; app can only verify

ipv6_privacy.reason: iOS uses private/temporary addresses by default; not app-toggleable

kernel.reason: no sysctl / kernel access in the app sandbox

mac.reason: 'Private Wi-Fi Address' is on per-network by default; not app-controllable

telemetry.reason: block telemetry domains via a Network Extension DNS proxy / content filter

tor.reason: route through Tor via a Packet Tunnel Provider

webcam_off.reason: camera is permission-gated only; no disable primitive

wireguard.reason: WireGuard via NEVPNManager with the Network Extension entitlement

home.description: Sane hardening for a trusted LAN. Blocks telemetry and local discovery, raises a stealth firewall, and randomizes the MAC per network â€” while staying usable (no killswitch, no radios off).

normal.description: Baseline. Every control off / asserting nothing. Applying this profile is the supported way to "return the machine to stock" â€” it restores the snapshots of whatever the previously active profile changed.

paranoid.description: Go dark. Maximum reduction of observable signature and attack surface. MAC fully randomized (or radios killed), zero local broadcasts, no listening services, traffic over Tor (or radios off entirely), telemetry sinkholed. NOTE: "radios off" is the only true-invisibility setting; with wifi permitted the device is still an RF emitter and detectable as such.

travel.description: Hostile-network mode. Assume the LAN and ISP are adversarial: MAC randomized, all local discovery silenced, Bluetooth off, all traffic forced through the tunnel with a killswitch, and known telemetry sinkholed.

audit.score: 0-100 over the profile's REQUIRED, gradeable capabilities; null when none are gradeable. Never a fake 100.
